blocks:
Yes—Happy Tails lists cat boarding in condos. For Luna, **January 12–15, 2027** spans **4 billed days**, so a Large Condo is estimated at **$128** ($32/day). The full-day charge applies regardless of drop-off time, and prices may change.

turns.customer: Boarding my cat Luna Jan 12-15 2027. She has her rabies shot. Is that all she needs?
blocks:
Rabies is **not the only listed vaccination requirement** for cat boarding. Happy Tails also requires written proof of a **distemper combination vaccine** that covers feline distemper, rhinotracheitis, and calicivirus. Its listed validity period for both vaccines is 1–3 years, depending on age and vaccine. The resort recommends giving vaccinations at least two weeks before boarding; check with Luna’s veterinarian about her records and timing. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/vaccination-requirements-policies?utm_source=openai))

For **January 12–15, 2027**, reservations are required. If those dates are treated as a holiday period, a **$50-per-condo deposit** and five-day cancellation notice apply; the resort says advance booking for holidays can vary from two weeks to two months. I can’t confirm whether those dates are classified as a holiday or whether space is available. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))
